My experience at LTIMindtree has proved to be totally rewarding for me.
From the very first day, the entire organization has offered a learning and friendly working environment where learning and developing have been promoted. The training sessions and working on live projects under experienced mentors have helped improve my technical and professional development.
LTIMindtree embraces innovation, collaboration and process improvement. The management's approach to communication and growth and development of employees is very genuine and feedback driven. It's a wonderful place to build a career and work since the work environment there embraces collaboration and work-life balance.
In conclusion, LTIMindtree is a truly great company that focuses on enabling employees, developing talents and offering opportunities for learning, contributing and achieving. It is pleasure to work for a company that synchronizes personal development with organizational success.
reviews.cons: Some of the processes can be slow but it happens in all the organization. Overall, I do not think that I dislike anything. Everything is better.

reviews.pros: My experience at LTIMindtree has been highly positive because of the collaborative work culture and the emphasis on continuous learning. The organization provides ample opportunities for skill development through training programs and exposure to cutting-edge work-life balance and employee well-being, which creates an environment where people feel valued and supported. Additionally, the leadship is approachable and encourages innovation, making it a great place to contribute and thrive.
reviews.cons: While LTIMindtree offers a great work environment overall, one area that could be improved is the speed of decision-making and reducing process overhead in certain workflows. At times, multiple layers of approvals can slow down execution, especially in fast-paced projects where agility is critical. Steamlining these processes and empowering teams with more automnomy would enhance efficiently and help us respond quicker to client needs.

reviews.pros: special leave on birthday and anniversary. They release salary on 28th.
reviews.cons:
Despite consistently receiving OP rating and being recognized as a top performer, the increment percentage has remained limited to around 4-5% which feels quite discouraging. Over the past 3 years, the annual appraisal cycle has repeatedly been pushed by one quarter, and this year, for some employee, it has been delayed further by two quarters, that mean if employee worked for 4 years still, they would receive the hike for 3 years, which is very demotivating.
Additionally, the current salary structure is not very employee friendly. A large portion of the compensation is included under CTC, resulting in significant deductions are leaving limited take-home pay. Referral efforts are also not giving due importance, as candidates are not interviewed even when relevant openings exist.
There have been multiple instances where employees have gone above and beyond their regular duties-working weekends and even supporting on national holidays- yet shift allowances are not always honored, citing lack of approvals. At times, employees are also advised not to fill timesheets, which is quite demotivating.
Regarding leave policies, the medical leave requirements are quite stringent. Even in genuine medical situations, employees are asked for extensive documentation, and if the leave is less than three days, it is usually adjusted against paid leave. This started happening after LTI merger, Mindtree never did this kind of injustice with their employees. 
Overall, the work culture reflects a significant level of micromanagement, and interactions with higher management often lack transparent communication and employee centric decision-making. I sincerely hope that these concerns are acknowledged and addressed to build a more supportive and motivating environment for everyone.
